generations.name: Original (2017-2020)
generations.notes: Launch. Long Range ~75 kWh (DC up to 250 kW after the 2019 V3 update); Standard Range / Standard Range Plus ~50-54 kWh. US deliveries started July 2017 (MY2017); Canadian deliveries started in 2018, so Canada's first year is effectively 2018 (general knowledge, not checked on a cited page). Peak DC rose by over-the-air update in 2019, which changes curves within this entry. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tesla_Model_3

generations.name: 2021 refresh
generations.notes: Long Range pack grows to ~82 kWh (Panasonic cells), heat pump added. From about MY2022, RWD/SR+ cars in North America use an LFP pack (~57.5-60 kWh). Pack changes happened by build date, not cleanly by model year (Tesla does not do annual model-year changeovers). The LFP RWD timing (late 2021 / MY2022) was not confirmed on a fetched page. Consider modelling the LFP RWD as a variant inside this entry. Confidence: low (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://insideevs.com/news/519345/bjorn-tesla-model3-lr-range/ ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tesla_Model_3

generations.name: Highland refresh
generations.notes: Highland refresh (about 50% new parts). RWD LFP ~60-64 kWh (DC up to ~170 kW); Long Range / Premium ~78-82 kWh (DC up to 250 kW). A cheaper Model 3 Standard arrived Oct 2025. Same year in CA and US. The Oct 2025 Model 3 Standard is a variant addition (smaller pack), not a line-wide change. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tesla_Model_3 ; https://insideevs.com/news/704076/2024-tesla-model3-highland-range-specs-pricing/
